headline_hook: Claude Turns Chemist, Gemma 4 Ships QAT, and Opus 4.1 Gets a Death Date
preview_topics: Claude matching chemists at NMR spectroscopy

pick_of_the_day.thesis: When a model matches domain experts at interpreting raw NMR spectra — not answering textbook questions — we've crossed from AI-as-tutor to AI-as-colleague in hard science, and the implications for drug discovery and materials science pipelines are immediate.

model_literacy.relevance: Gemma 4's QAT checkpoints trained with quantization baked in from the start, not bolted on after — today's release is a good moment to understand why QAT models hold quality at INT4/INT8 while post-hoc methods like GPTQ and AWQ degrade.

items.title: Claude Cowork Doubles Rate Limits for the Next 30 Days
items.angle: Time-boxed window to stress-test multi-agent workflows on real projects before limits snap back — teams should front-load their most ambitious Cowork experiments now.
items.key_fact: 5-hour rate limits doubled across all Cowork tiers for one month

items.title: Gemma 4 QAT Checkpoints Land on Hugging Face Across All Sizes
items.angle: Google ships models trained with quantization in mind rather than compressed after the fact — expect meaningfully better INT4/INT8 quality than standard GPTQ or AWQ conversions.
items.key_fact: All Gemma 4 model sizes available with quantization-aware trained weights

items.title: Google Ships Nano Banana 2, Co-Scientist, and Dreambeans in One Week
items.angle: Three GA releases in a single week signals Google's shipping cadence is now matching its announcement cadence.
items.key_fact: Nano Banana 2 GA via Gemini API, Co-Scientist for structured scientific hypotheses

items.title: Higgs Audio v3 — A 4B TTS Model Small Enough to Self-Host
items.angle: BosonAI's 4B-parameter TTS model is compact enough for on-prem deployment while trending hard on community benchmarks.
items.key_fact: 4B parameters — small enough for single-GPU self-hosting

items.title: Opus 4.7 Matches Human Experts at NMR Spectroscopy — Not Textbook Questions, Real Spectra
items.angle: The first convincing evidence that frontier models can do real analytical chemistry — interpreting raw spectral data, not regurgitating known structures.
items.key_fact: Opus 4.7 matches or exceeds expert chemists on NMR spectral interpretation

items.title: Sakana AI Opens the First Lab Dedicated to Recursive Self-Improvement
items.angle: The evolutionary model merging team now has a dedicated RSI Lab in Tokyo — making open-ended self-improvement an explicit research agenda rather than a side project.
items.key_fact: First dedicated lab with recursive self-improvement as its stated mission

items.title: NVIDIA's NitroGen Wins CVPR Honorable Mention for Physics-General Embodied Agents
items.angle: Four years from MineDojo to agents that transfer across multiple physics simulations — NVIDIA's embodied AI roadmap is delivering on generalization.

items.title: Cog Ships 100-Hour Agent Evals With Financial Guarantees on Accuracy
items.angle: First company confident enough to put money behind agent evaluation results — evals run 6x longer than METR's 16-hour ceiling using GPT-5 to estimate human-equivalent time.
items.key_fact: 100-hour agent benchmarks with financial accuracy guarantees

items.title: Opus 4.1 Gets a Hard Retirement Date: August 5, 2026
items.angle: If you're still pinned to claude-opus-4-1 in production, the migration clock is now ticking — two months to move to Opus 4.8 or face breakage.

items.title: TanStack AI Adds First-Class MCP Support With CLI Typegen
items.angle: Managed server lifecycle, pooled connections, and CLI-generated types — the MCP integration layer you'd otherwise hand-build for React/Vue/Solid apps.
items.key_fact: Standalone or pooled MCP connections with TypeScript type generation

items.title: The Official Claude Cowork Product Guide Drops
items.angle: Definitive playbook for multi-agent delegation patterns — pairs perfectly with today's doubled limits for teams ready to go deep on Cowork.
items.key_fact: Official guide covering team delegation patterns and best practices

items.title: Anthropic TypeScript SDK v0.101.0 Adds Middleware Support
items.angle: Intercept, transform, or log requests and responses without wrapping the client — clean extensibility for observability and retry logic.
items.key_fact: New middleware API for request/response interception

items.title: Your RL Environment Might Be Sabotaging Your Model
items.angle: Latent Space catalogs specific RL environment anti-patterns from real training trajectories — if you're fine-tuning with RL, check your harness against this list.
items.key_fact: Documented anti-patterns that actively make trained models worse

items.title: How an Anthropic Sales Lead Rebuilt GTM Workflows With Claude Code
items.angle: Internal case study proving non-engineers can use Claude Code to automate real business workflows — patterns directly applicable to sales and ops teams.
items.key_fact: Non-engineering team member automated GTM workflows end-to-end

items.title: Reports Surface of Claude API Returning Another User's Output During Outage
items.angle: Unconfirmed cross-tenant data leakage during today's elevated-error window — Anthropic hasn't confirmed a leak, but teams sending sensitive data through the API should monitor closely.
items.key_fact: Anthropic status page confirmed elevated errors; data leak unconfirmed

items.title: Mythos Pricing Leak: $70/M Output Tokens and the Coming Frontier Tax
items.angle: At 3.5x current Opus pricing, the frontier is creating real market segmentation — teams need to decide which tasks are worth frontier spend and which aren't.
items.key_fact: $70 per 1M output tokens — 3.5x current Opus pricing

items.title: Did Claude Actually Increase Bugs in rsync? An Independent Analysis
items.angle: High-engagement analysis of AI-authored code quality in critical infrastructure — a useful data point as AI-written code percentages climb across the industry.
items.key_fact: Independent analysis with 270 likes and 259 RTs on the findings

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B BF16 Weights Now Downloadable
items.angle: Full BF16 weights for the 550B MoE model are live — 9K+ downloads already as the community stress-tests NVIDIA's open agent backbone.
